data.name: Smriti
data.gender_notes: Smriti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root smṛ, 'to remember' — smṛti, 'memory, tradition'. Its root is Sanskrit smṛ (स्मृ). A body of Hindu traditional texts. Smriti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Memory; recollection; tradition”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Smriti expresses “Memory; recollection; tradition”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root smṛ, 'to remember' — smṛti, 'memory, tradition'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Smriti total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
